provider.Name: AI provider
provider.Hint: Service used for generation. "None" turns generation off without affecting the rest of the world.

endpoint.Name: Service address
endpoint.Hint: Leave empty for the provider's default address.

textModel.Name: Text model
textModel.Hint: Identifier of the model used for text.

imageModel.Name: Image model
imageModel.Hint: Identifier of the model used for images (optional).

apiKey.Name: API key
apiKey.Hint: Stored in this browser only, never in the world: players cannot read it.

imageSameAsText.Name: Same service as text
imageSameAsText.Hint: Uncheck to generate images with another service (for example Claude for text, OpenAI for images).

imageProvider.Name: Image provider
imageProvider.Hint: Service used for images. Claude does not generate images and is not offered here.

imageEndpoint.Name: Image service address
imageEndpoint.Hint: Leave empty for the provider's default address.

imageApiKey.Name: Image service API key
imageApiKey.Hint: Stored in this browser only, never in the world.

Status.NoProvider: Choose an AI provider in the module settings.
Status.MissingApiKey: Enter the API key in the module settings (GM's browser).
Status.MissingTextModel: Enter the text model in the module settings.
Status.MissingImageModel: Enter the image model in the AI provider window.
Status.NoImageGeneration: Claude does not generate images: choose a separate image service.

Provider.Title: AI Them'All: AI provider
Provider.MenuHint: Service, address, API key, connection test and model choice.
Provider.TestFirst: Test the connection to pick models from a list.
Provider.NoImageModels: This service offers no image model.

Errors.missingApiKey: This provider needs an API key.
Errors.network: Service unreachable. Check the address; for Ollama, allow Foundry's origin (OLLAMA_ORIGINS variable). {detail}
Errors.auth: API key rejected by the service ({detail}).
Errors.badResponse: Unexpected response: the address does not look like this kind of service.
Errors.noModel: No model chosen for this service: open the AI provider window.
Errors.noImageGeneration: This service cannot generate images: choose an OpenAI-compatible service for images.

Provider.ClaudeNoImages: Claude does not generate images: uncheck "Same service as text" to pick an image service.

Card.Name: Name
Card.TargetHint: One field of a sheet, or any field of the same kind.

PromptHint.text: What the AI must write. Only these words, the GM's details and the Document's name are sent.
PromptHint.image: What the image must show, and its style.

Card.UseCurrentHint: Also sends the text already in the field, to improve it rather than start over.
Card.Invalid: The target field is gone or changed kind: choose another one.

Generate.Title: Generate with AI
Generate.ResultHint: You may touch up the text before validating.
Generate.Conflict: The field changed since this window opened: nothing was written. Generate again.
Generate.WrittenDraft: Field updated in the Ruleset draft.
Generate.UploadFailed: The image could not be saved in the world.

Designer.Title: Describe your rule (AI)
Designer.Intro: Describe a rule in words: the AI picks a path and fills its answers. You check the preview and click Apply; nothing is written before.
Designer.Placeholder: E.g.: Burst of 1, 2 or 3 sequences of 3 bullets, +2 if the sequence fits in the attacks per round…
Designer.Review: Check the preview below, then click Apply.
Designer.Question: The AI needs a detail:
Designer.NoPath: No assistant path expresses this rule.
Designer.Invalid: The assistant still refuses the proposal after two fixes; the answers are in the form for you to correct:
Designer.ReadOnly: This Ruleset is validated: the assistant is read-only.
Designer.ConsentIntro: To propose paths, AI Them'All sends to the configured AI service:
Designer.ConsentCatalog: the list of the assistant's {count} paths and their questions;
Designer.ConsentEntries: the names and ids of the Ruleset entries the chosen path may reuse.
Designer.ConsentNever: Nothing else leaves the world: never the characters' sheets. This is asked once in this browser.
